India's 'Savings Plan' for Delhi Residents Gets a Major Update

The Indian government has announced an update to its 'Delhi Lakshmi Yojana', a program aimed at supporting low-income residents. The plan now promises ₹2500 per month, with recipients receiving ₹1000 in cash. The move is seen as part of the government's efforts to address poverty and inequality.
